hunks.baseline: At the edge of the island, near the sandy shore, several dozen people had gathered.
hunks.sol: Several dozen people had gathered near the sandy shore at the far end of the island.

hunks.baseline: When the martial artists surrounding us opened a path, I finally spotted some familiar faces.
hunks.sol: When the martial artists surrounding them opened a path for us, I finally spotted some familiar faces.

hunks.baseline: “Uncle Hwang! How could you leave without your nephew? How could you!”
hunks.sol: “Uncle Hwang! How could you leave your nephew behind? How could you!”

hunks.baseline: Mu Song wailed in a hoarse voice. Perfected Being Hyeongong of Wudang watched him with a sorrowful expression, while Crouching Dragon Guest Zhuge Feng watched with a profound, unreadable gaze.
hunks.sol: Mu Song wailed himself hoarse. Perfected Being Hyeongong of Wudang watched him with sorrow, while Crouching Dragon Guest Zhuge Feng regarded the scene with a profound, unreadable gaze.

hunks.baseline: Usually, Mungyeong had a presence that was there and yet not there, never drawing attention to himself among the others. But from the instant he realized something had happened at Donghu Stronghold, he had moved more quickly than anyone.
hunks.sol: Mungyeong usually faded into the background, barely making his presence felt among the others. But from the moment he realized something had happened at Donghu Stronghold, he had moved faster than anyone.

hunks.baseline: As a medical apprentice rather than a Slaughter Saint, he had rushed from place to place in an effort to save even a single person.
hunks.sol: Not as the Slaughter Saint, but as a medical apprentice, he had rushed everywhere in an effort to save even a single life.

hunks.baseline: But as though mocking all his efforts, not a single survivor remained.
hunks.sol: But as if to mock his efforts, there wasn’t a single survivor.

hunks.baseline: The corpse Mu Song clutched as he wept endlessly belonged to one of the countless victims claimed by the tragedy.
hunks.sol: The corpse Mu Song clutched as he wept was merely one of the countless victims of the tragedy.

hunks.baseline: “It may be difficult to recognize him, but according to what we have determined, there is no doubt.”
hunks.sol: “It may be difficult to recognize him, but from what we’ve determined, there can be no doubt.”

hunks.baseline: It might sound inappropriate to use such a word when referring to the dead.
hunks.sol: It might have sounded inappropriate to use such a word for the dead.

hunks.baseline: But anyone who had seen the corpse of Yangtze One Saber Hwang Chung in person would have been unable to object. I was no different.
hunks.sol: But anyone who saw Yangtze One Saber Hwang Chung’s corpse in person would have found it hard to object. I was no different.

hunks.baseline: The corpse had been so badly mutilated that it was difficult to believe it had once been a living person.
hunks.sol: The corpse was so badly mutilated that it was difficult to believe it had once been a living person.

hunks.baseline: The face had been crushed as if it had been smashed with a rock, and below the chest, there was simply no body left.
hunks.sol: His face looked as if it had been pounded with a boulder, and there was simply nothing below his chest.

hunks.baseline: The stench of rotting flesh and viscera stabbed at my nose.
hunks.sol: The stench of rotting flesh and entrails stabbed at my nose.

hunks.baseline: I could not blame Hyuk Mujin for staggering backward with a retch.
hunks.sol: I couldn’t blame Hyuk Mujin for staggering backward with a retch.

hunks.baseline: Even I, who had witnessed more gruesome scenes and corpses than I could count, felt my stomach churn.
hunks.sol: Even my stomach churned, and I had seen more corpses and gruesome scenes than I could count.

hunks.baseline: The sworn brother of the Seafaring King, a Supreme Peak master who had ruled the vast Yangtze with his formidable martial arts…
hunks.sol: The sworn brother of the Seafaring King. A Supreme Peak master who had ruled the vast Yangtze with his formidable martial arts.

hunks.baseline: Yangtze One Saber Hwang Chung looked more like a lump of meat than a corpse.
hunks.sol: Yangtze One Saber Hwang Chung now looked more like a lump of meat than a corpse.

hunks.baseline: “It’s horrifying. What kind of fiend would commit such an atrocity?”
hunks.sol: “It’s horrifying. What kind of godforsaken bastard would do this?”

hunks.baseline: I stared at the corpse with my face stiff as stone, then suddenly felt something strange and opened my mouth.
hunks.sol: I stared grimly at the corpse until something struck me as odd.

hunks.baseline: “What are those corpses?”
hunks.sol: “Who are those two?”

hunks.baseline: There were corpses covering the island, so it was not surprising that there were a few more.
hunks.sol: The island was littered with bodies, so a few more were hardly surprising.

hunks.baseline: But the two corpses I had noticed had been laid out side by side next to Yangtze One Saber Hwang Chung.
hunks.sol: But the two corpses I had noticed were laid side by side next to Yangtze One Saber Hwang Chung.

hunks.baseline: *That must mean they were important figures as well.*
hunks.sol: *They must have been important, too.*

hunks.baseline: “Mad Water Saber Demon Hwang Cheol. And Wave Fox Do Ripgun.”
hunks.sol: “Mad Water Saber Demon Hwang Cheol and Wave Fox Do Ripgun.”

hunks.baseline: “Mad Water Saber Demon, Wave Fox…”
hunks.sol: “Mad Water Saber Demon… Wave Fox…”

hunks.baseline: I had heard those names a few times before. Fairly recently, too.
hunks.sol: I had heard those names a few times before, and fairly recently.

hunks.baseline: After a brief moment of thought, I suddenly lifted my head.
hunks.sol: After a brief search of my memory, my head snapped up.

hunks.baseline: “That’s right. They were the Stronghold Lords of Dangyang Stronghold and Honghu Stronghold, which were under Dongting Lake.”
hunks.sol: “That’s right. They were the Stronghold Lords of Dangyang Stronghold and Honghu Stronghold, the two strongholds on Dongting Lake.”

hunks.baseline: “Weren’t they said to have vanished without a trace after taking control of the Sea Serpent Society’s territory?”
hunks.sol: “Weren’t they the ones who vanished without a trace after seizing the Sea Serpent Society’s territory?”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. That was certainly the case.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. They certainly were.”

hunks.baseline: Zhuge Feng continued, his deep eyes fixed on the corpses of the two Stronghold Lords.
hunks.sol: Zhuge Feng continued, his deep gaze fixed on the bodies of the two Stronghold Lords.

hunks.baseline: “The Mad Water Saber Demon was hot-tempered, while the Wave Fox was cunning. That was why, when the Sea Serpent Society incident occurred a month ago, everyone had no choice but to suspect them.”
hunks.sol: “The Mad Water Saber Demon was hot-tempered, while the Wave Fox was cunning. That was why everyone had no choice but to suspect them when the Sea Serpent Society incident occurred a month ago.”

hunks.baseline: “My Master once said that only two people in the Yangtze River Channel League were capable of controlling the Mad Water Saber Demon and the Wave Fox.”
hunks.sol: “My Master once told me that only two people in the Yangtze River Channel League could keep the Mad Water Saber Demon and the Wave Fox under control.”

hunks.baseline: “That is correct. Regardless of their personalities, both possessed formidable martial arts. Without a leash to control them, they would have run wild like vicious hounds.”
hunks.sol: “That is correct. Whatever their personalities, both possessed formidable martial arts. Without a leash to restrain them, they would have run wild like vicious hounds.”

hunks.baseline: In that sense, Yangtze One Saber Hwang Chung would have been the perfect leash for those vicious hounds.
hunks.sol: In that sense, Yangtze One Saber Hwang Chung would have made the perfect leash.

hunks.baseline: He was the second most powerful master in the Yangtze River Channel League after the Seafaring King, and he must also have been exceptionally skilled at handling people.
hunks.sol: He was the second strongest master in the Yangtze River Channel League after the Seafaring King, and he must have been exceptionally skilled at handling people as well.

hunks.baseline: But the sturdy leash had snapped, and the two vicious hounds had also been found dead.
hunks.sol: But that sturdy leash had snapped, and the two vicious hounds had been found dead beside him.

hunks.baseline: Even the Yangtze River Channel League in Hubei Province, which had been locked in a fierce struggle over interests with the Sea Serpent Society for a long time, had been laid to waste.
hunks.sol: The Yangtze River Channel League’s forces in Hubei Province, which had fought the Sea Serpent Society over local interests for years, had also been laid to waste.

hunks.baseline: And there was only one group capable of doing something like this without reason or justification.
hunks.sol: And there was only one group that could commit such an act without reason or justification.

hunks.baseline: No—perhaps Dark Heaven had been standing atop the world for a very long time.
hunks.sol: No—perhaps Dark Heaven had stood astride the world for a very long time.

hunks.baseline: Perhaps we simply had not felt its shadow because it had been night, with not a single ray of light.
hunks.sol: Perhaps we simply hadn’t noticed its shadow because the world had been plunged into a moonless night.

hunks.baseline: This was not some scheme that had begun yesterday or today. It was a sinister plot that had been taking shape since the time of the Great Faction War.
hunks.sol: This scheme hadn’t begun yesterday or the day before. It had been taking shape since the time of the Great Faction War.

hunks.baseline: “An age of chaos. This is truly an age of chaos.”
hunks.sol: “An age of chaos. We have truly entered an age of chaos.”

hunks.baseline: Crouching Dragon Guest Zhuge Feng muttered the words under his breath, then raised his head and looked around.
hunks.sol: Crouching Dragon Guest Zhuge Feng muttered under his breath, then raised his head and looked around.

hunks.baseline: A pair of eyes gleaming with an unknowable light stared into the thick fog surrounding us.
hunks.sol: His eyes gleamed with an inscrutable light as he stared into the thick fog on every side.

hunks.baseline: It was as though he could see through it, straight to something crouching beyond.
hunks.sol: It was as if he could see through it to something crouching beyond.

hunks.baseline: Everyone, myself and my companions included, moved busily.
hunks.sol: Everyone, including my companions and me, sprang into action.

hunks.baseline: But even after searching every corner of the island and the surrounding cliffs in the hope of finding a single survivor or witness, we gained nothing.
hunks.sol: But even after thoroughly searching the island and the surrounding cliffs for a single survivor or witness, we found nothing.

hunks.baseline: If anything, our questions and frustration only grew.
hunks.sol: If anything, we were left with even more questions and frustration.

hunks.baseline: *I can accept that there isn’t a single survivor. But how can there be no trace of a formation, either?*
hunks.sol: *It’s one thing for there to be no survivors, but how can there be no trace of a formation, either?*

hunks.baseline: If Dark Heaven had entered this place through a Moving Formation without passing through Tianling Falls, there had to be traces somewhere resembling those we had found in Sichuan.
hunks.sol: If Dark Heaven had reached this place through a Moving Formation instead of passing through Tianling Falls, traces like the ones we had found in Sichuan had to remain somewhere nearby.

hunks.baseline: Yet even after the retainers of the Zhuge Clan, famed for their knowledge of formations and mechanisms, joined the search, we had nothing to show for it.
hunks.sol: Yet even after retainers of the Zhuge Clan, renowned for their knowledge of formations and mechanisms, joined the search, we had nothing to show for it.

hunks.baseline: The situation was so strange that Zhuge Feng eventually came to ask me about it.
hunks.sol: Even Zhuge Feng eventually came to question me.

hunks.baseline: “Are you certain such a formation really exists?”
hunks.sol: “Are you certain such a formation truly exists?”

hunks.baseline: “I told you, it does. We left Henan immediately after everything was over, so we couldn’t search for it there. But during the Sichuan Blood Tragedy, I saw it clearly with my own two eyes.”
hunks.sol: “I told you, it does. We left Henan as soon as everything was over, so we couldn’t search for it there. But during the Sichuan Blood Tragedy, I saw it clearly with my own two eyes.”

hunks.baseline: “I knew about it through the letters I received, but even our family’s records contain no trace of such a strange formation.”
hunks.sol: “I knew of it from the letters I received, but no such bizarre formation exists in our family’s records.”

hunks.baseline: “Then add it to the records this time.”
hunks.sol: “Then this is your chance to add it.”

hunks.baseline: “If we keep looking, we’ll find it. We have to.”
hunks.sol: “It’s here somewhere. We have to find it.”

hunks.baseline: “I agree. But the people gathered here are insufficient.”
hunks.sol: “I agree. But the people gathered here are not enough.”

hunks.baseline: The island Donghu Stronghold had made its headquarters was large enough, but the surrounding environment was an even greater problem.
hunks.sol: The sheer size of the island Donghu Stronghold had made its headquarters was one problem, but the surrounding terrain was an even greater one.

hunks.baseline: Cliffs hundreds of zhang long surrounded it on every side, making entry by land impossible, and an even wider expanse of river stretched beyond them.
hunks.sol: Cliffs stretching hundreds of zhang surrounded it on every side, making it impossible to approach by land, while an even greater expanse of river lay beyond them.

hunks.baseline: Four fast ships and roughly three hundred people could only accomplish so much.
hunks.sol: With only four swift ships and roughly three hundred people, there was a limit to how much we could search.

hunks.baseline: “It was a mistake to select people skilled in martial arts. We should have brought retainers with a deep understanding of formations.”
hunks.sol: “It was a mistake to select people for their martial prowess. We should have brought retainers well versed in formations.”

hunks.baseline: There was no point regretting it now.
hunks.sol: Regretting it now wouldn’t change anything.

hunks.baseline: Not only Zhuge Feng but everyone present, myself included, had been worried about a bloody conflict with the Yangtze River Channel League. None of us had dreamed that a situation like this would be waiting for us.
hunks.sol: Zhuge Feng, myself, and everyone else here had been worried about a bloody clash with the Yangtze River Channel League. None of us had dreamed that this would be waiting for us.

hunks.baseline: “It would be best for me, as Family Head, to go myself, but under the circumstances, that seems to be our best option. I’ll have several retainers from our family accompany you. Take them with you.”
hunks.sol: “It would be best if I went myself as Family Head, but under the circumstances, that appears to be our best option. I’ll assign several of our retainers to accompany you.”

hunks.baseline: “Does that ‘we’ you mentioned include this old man?”
hunks.sol: “Does that ‘we’ of yours include this old man?”

hunks.baseline: “Of course. Don’t you know the saying? Wherever a needle goes, the thread follows.”
hunks.sol: “Of course. Don’t you know the saying? Wherever the needle goes, the thread follows.”

hunks.baseline: When I flinched, Jeok Cheongang clenched his fist and threatened me.
hunks.sol: I flinched, and Jeok Cheongang clenched his fist menacingly.

hunks.baseline: “What, are you planning to stay here for the rest of your life? Never leave?”
hunks.sol: “What, are you planning to live here for the rest of your life? Are you never leaving?”

hunks.baseline: “Who said this old man was staying forever? There’s no need for everyone to swarm off. If even one extra person stays behind to help find the formation, we can uncover the culprit and restore peace to Hubei, can’t we?”
hunks.sol: “Who said this old man would stay forever? There’s no need for everyone to rush off together. If even one more person remains behind to help search for the formation, we can uncover the culprit and restore peace to Hubei, can’t we?”

hunks.baseline: Ever since his friend, the Dharma King Hong Dao, had been killed by Dark Heaven, Jeok Cheongang had ground his teeth at so much as the first syllable of its name. But there was something suspicious about his reaction this time.
hunks.sol: Ever since his friend, the Dharma King Hong Dao, had been killed by Dark Heaven, Jeok Cheongang had ground his teeth at the mere mention of its name. Yet something about his reaction this time didn’t add up.

hunks.baseline: “Ah. Now I understand. This is because of Tianling Falls.”
hunks.sol: “Ah. Now I get it. It’s because of Tianling Falls.”

hunks.baseline: “You should have just said so instead of beating around the bush. I forgot to take that into account, too.”
hunks.sol: “You should’ve just said so instead of beating around the bush. I forgot to take that into account.”

hunks.baseline: After taking about seven blows to the back of the head, I ran away and headed toward our next destination.
hunks.sol: After taking about seven blows to the back of the head, I fled and headed toward my next destination.

hunks.baseline: The familiar faces gathered in one place turned toward me.
hunks.sol: The familiar faces gathered nearby turned toward me.

hunks.baseline: I answered while giving Hyuk Mujin a light kick to the butt.
hunks.sol: I gave Hyuk Mujin a light kick in the butt as I answered.

hunks.baseline: “The Zhuge Clan. It seems we need to bring back people skilled in formations and mechanisms. If necessary, we’ll also bring in reinforcements from Wudang. I heard they have several Daoists who are well versed in formations.”
hunks.sol: “The Zhuge Clan. We need to bring back people skilled in formations and mechanisms. If necessary, we’ll get reinforcements from Wudang, too. I heard they have several Daoists well versed in formations.”

hunks.baseline: “I’m afraid Wudang may be difficult.”
hunks.sol: “Wudang might be difficult.”

hunks.baseline: “Hmm. Now that I think about it, there must be a good reason for him to say that.”
hunks.sol: “Hmm. Now that I think about it, he must have had a good reason.”

hunks.baseline: “Whatever. Explain it properly. What do you mean?”
hunks.sol: “Whatever. Explain. What do you mean?”

hunks.baseline: “It seems there’s been trouble on Wudang’s side as well. Even before the Sea Serpent Society incident, some mad killer demon had been murdering people throughout Hubei Province… It appears the situation has grown serious. More than thirty people have already been killed by his hand, so I suppose it would.”
hunks.sol: “It seems Wudang has troubles of its own. Even before the Sea Serpent Society incident, some madman they’re calling the Killing Ghost had been murdering people throughout Hubei Province… Apparently, the situation has grown serious. More than thirty people have already died by his hand, so I suppose that’s no surprise.”

hunks.baseline: “A killer demon? Is he a martial artist?”
hunks.sol: “The Killing Ghost? Is he a martial artist?”

hunks.baseline: “He certainly seems to be a martial artist of considerable skill. Most of the victims were commoners, but an accomplished First Rate wandering martial artist with a respectable name was reportedly found dead after accepting a government assignment to hunt him down.”
hunks.sol: “He certainly seems to be a martial artist of considerable skill. Most of his victims were commoners, but a fairly renowned First Rate wandering martial artist was reportedly found dead after accepting a government commission to hunt him down.”

hunks.baseline: A first-class wandering martial artist would be considered a First Rate master wherever he went.
hunks.sol: A First Rate wandering martial artist would be considered a First Rate master wherever he went.

hunks.baseline: If the killer demon from the rumors had really disposed of a First Rate wandering martial artist with ease and escaped, there was a good chance he was a Peak master.
hunks.sol: If the rumored Killing Ghost had truly disposed of one with ease and escaped, there was a good chance he was a Peak master.

hunks.baseline: *But Wudang wouldn’t mobilize the entire sect just to catch one man.*
hunks.sol: *Still, Wudang wouldn’t mobilize the entire sect just to catch one man.*

hunks.baseline: The question that had arisen in my mind vanished at Gung Gibang’s next words.
hunks.sol: The question vanished at Gung Gibang’s next words.

hunks.baseline: “Was it three days ago? Twenty pilgrims climbing Mount Wudang were slaughtered to a person. Among them were the sons and daughters of high officials and nobles who were seeking admission as lay disciples of Wudang.”
hunks.sol: “Was it three days ago? Twenty pilgrims climbing Mount Wudang were massacred. Among them were children of high officials and nobles who intended to enter Wudang as lay disciples.”

hunks.baseline: It was not merely a massacre that had taken place somewhere else. It had happened on Mount Wudang itself.
hunks.sol: This hadn’t happened just anywhere. The massacre had taken place on Mount Wudang itself.

hunks.baseline: As if pilgrims being massacred right in Wudang’s own front yard weren’t enough, the victims included children of high officials and nobles. Wudang’s fury was only natural.
hunks.sol: As if slaughtering pilgrims in Wudang’s own front yard weren’t enough, the bastard had killed the children of high officials and nobles. Wudang’s fury was only natural.

hunks.baseline: *He’s completely insane. And bold, too.*
hunks.sol: *He’s completely insane. Bold, too.*

hunks.baseline: For a moment, the two words *Dark Heaven* crossed my mind, but I soon shook my head.
hunks.sol: For a moment, the words *Dark Heaven* crossed my mind, but I soon shook my head.

hunks.baseline: This was Murim. There were lunatics everywhere who made modern serial killers look like amateurs.
hunks.sol: This was Murim. It was full of lunatics who made modern serial killers look like amateurs.

hunks.baseline: Even if someone were murdered in broad daylight on a main road, it would not be all that surprising.
hunks.sol: Even a murder committed on a busy road in broad daylight wouldn’t be especially surprising.

hunks.baseline: *If Dark Heaven had done this, an incident incomparably larger would have erupted.*
hunks.sol: *If Dark Heaven had done it, something incomparably worse would’ve happened.*

hunks.baseline: In any case, that was the situation in Wudang. For now, we would have to think about it again after reaching the Zhuge Clan.
hunks.sol: In any case, that was Wudang’s situation. We could reconsider the matter after reaching the Zhuge Clan.

hunks.baseline: “Well, now that I know, everyone pack your things. They’re already preparing outside to take us back.”
hunks.sol: “Well, now that we know, everyone pack your things. The others outside are already getting ready to take us back.”

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung had already decided to remain behind even before we went to meet Zhuge Feng, so I only needed to take the people here with me.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung had already decided to remain behind before I went to meet Zhuge Feng, so I only needed to bring the people gathered here.

hunks.baseline: But one person—or rather, one gentleman—seemed to have a different idea.
hunks.sol: But one bastard—or rather, one gentleman—seemed to have other ideas.

hunks.baseline: “Is there any reason I should go with you?”
hunks.sol: “Is there any reason I need to accompany you?”
